body.name: Regular branch influence-function classes
body.construction:
Define
\[
 \mathcal I_b(P)=\{\phi\in\mathcal H_P:E_O[\phi s]=\dot\theta_b(s)
 \text{ for every }s\in\mathcal T_b(P)\}.
\]
Here \(\dot\theta_b\) is the derivative of the observed-law functional in \(\mathrm{def{:}branch\text{-}functionals}\); the affine normal form is a conclusion of \(\mathrm{lem{:}tangent\text{-}normal\text{-}form}\), not part of this definition.
